description: Nominal humanitarian operation, moderate load, no external shocks.
Population influx into a camp; terrestrial base stations congested.
Ionospheric scintillation and handover churn degrade the LEO segment.
Disaster/conflict zone: cascading loss of terrestrial and power infrastructure.
Non-terrestrial operation with periodic handover reconfiguration; timing and transient-degradation magnitudes are informed by published LEO measurement studies.
Regional common-cause disruption: shared power and backhaul dependencies inject a correlated shock into all elements of an affected region.

Externally anchored non-terrestrial operation: the reconfiguration cadence, its phase within the minute and the satellite-link latency statistics are taken from published Starlink measurement studies rather than from the link budget of this model. Held out of the training corpus.
